notes.title: Version 0.1.0
notes.content:
* New artistic direction
--- Replaced the "creepy" (as said by community) rabbit by realistic dog model, hope you enjoy it
------- Replaced vegetables by misc dog food in the vendor machine
------- Removed the farming system
--- 3D & 2D graphism improved
------- Realistic grass texture
------- Realistic tree model
------- Realistic skybox
* Pet's AI have been improved
---- Now the pet can walk around to find food
---- Pet can now go to toy to play by itself
---- Can run after a toy and you bring the toy
---- Pet go to hes "bedroom" before sleeping
* New environment
* New pet selection menu
* New economic system
* New background music
* Now player start new game with 1000 of money
* Vacuum have been removed
* Added more fruit trees
* Adding better translations (french & english)
* The sponge is now more effecient and use less humidity
* The height of the vendor machine & piggy's bank have been reduced
* The texts in menu are now more easily visible
* No more object attached to player's hand
* Now you can use the 2 hands to grab object or to teleport
* Toys coordinates are now saved
* Statusbars have been replaced by bubble image system for clearer and simple to understand informations
* Fixed some shadow & light problems
* Fixed problem with player height
* Fixed problem with teleportation
